title: Oversight Efficiency Pareto Frontier: Mapping the Tradeoff Between Oversight Cost and Quality

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: characterizing the cost-quality Pareto frontier directly informs practical deployment decisions about how much to invest in oversight. Connects directly to the Scaling Laws for Scalable Oversight line of work.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running oversight experiments at multiple compute budgets and measuring quality at each. The multi-budget sweep increases API costs and orchestration complexity. Doable with mentor guidance but not trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: A Pareto frontier requires many data points across the cost axis. Even scoped to a single task domain, generating enough budget levels and measuring quality at each requires substantial experimental effort. Tight for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
